body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Reduce your next forced movement by 1 unit until the start of your next turn.
Protect an adjacent willing ally against its next Damage as well.

rider.title: Adaptation - Bulwark
rider.html: Assume Plates (upkeep 0): while you have not moved since your last turn began, gain +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks.
